Watch a video about Bandwidth Classes, including about the Web Conferencing Applications bandwidth class (shows legacy UI).

The Web Conferencing Applications page allows you to enable or disable web conferencing applications. When configuring, it displays a list of web conferencing applications that can be included in this class. To learn more, see About Bandwidth Classes.

To manage applications that belong to this class:

From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > Bandwidth Classes.
Go to the Web Conferencing Applications tab.

Click Edit to enable or disable web conferencing applications.

See image

The Edit drawer appears.

In the Edit drawer, for the Web Conferencing Applications section, enable or disable applications as necessary.

See image.

Click Save and activate the changes.
